audit.empty: No audit records match the current filters.
audit.title: Audit Log

dedup.help: When consecutive screenshots are identical, send a short text note instead of the duplicate image. Saves tokens on long tasks.
dedup.label: Skip unchanged screenshots

behavior.description: How screenshots and typing are presented to the model.

pasteThreshold.help: Type actions longer than this many characters paste via the clipboard instead of typing key-by-key. 0 disables.
pasteThreshold.label: Paste threshold (characters)

scaling.help: Resize captures to fit the target size before sending to the model. Improves click accuracy and cuts token cost (1280×800 recommended).
scaling.label: Downscale screenshots

behavior.title: Model behavior

header.description: Configure desktop UI automation — screenshots, element finding, clicking, typing, and hotkeys.
header.title: Automation

inspector.clickToPopulate: Choose a root and click Refresh to populate the tree.
inspector.elementDetailsDescription: Properties and test patterns for the selected element.
inspector.emptyResult: No elements returned for the selected root.
inspector.pickCaptureNowTooltip: Skip the countdown and pick the element under the cursor immediately
inspector.pickStartTooltip: Start a 3-second countdown, then pick the element under the cursor
inspector.selectRow: Select an element from the tree to see details.
inspector.testPatternsHint: Invoke UIA patterns against the selected element to verify behavior.
inspector.treeDescription: Inspect the UIA/accessibility tree of a target window.
inspector.requiresTauri: The inspector requires the Tauri runtime so it can talk to the active accessibility back-end.
inspector.unavailable: The active platform back-end ({platform}) doesn't expose an accessibility tree yet, so there's nothing for the inspector to read. Tree support lands per platform in a later milestone.
inspector.a11yOnlyNote: This back-end reads the frontmost window's accessibility tree. Tree reading, element details, and locator export work here; element-targeted pattern tests and coordinate picking aren't available on this platform yet.

overview.engineStatusDescription: Toggle the automation engine on or off. When off the kill switch is engaged and all calls are rejected at the gate.
overview.engineToggleHint: When enabled, automations respect the permission tiers configured below.

initFailure.body: The platform automation backend ({platform}) failed to start: {error}. Computer Use calls will return UnsupportedPlatform until the underlying issue is resolved. Check the troubleshooting guide for your OS or restart the app after fixing permissions.
initFailure.title: Backend initialization failed

overview.killSwitchHint: Immediately rejects all in-flight automation calls. Use when the engine behaves unexpectedly.

metrics.description: Activity counters from the audit log. Updates on tab mount and every 60s.
metrics.lastScreenshotDescription: Time the most recent successful screenshot was captured.
metrics.title: Last 24 hours
metrics.topFailingDescription: Commands with the most deny / consent-decline outcomes in the last 24h. Investigate when a single command dominates.
metrics.topFailingEmpty: No denied calls in the last 24h.

permissions.defaultTierDescription: The tier applied when no per-surface override is set.

perPlugin.description: Plugins that declare native:input or native:screen permissions can be granted a different tier than the catch-all Plugin surface. Useful for trusting one specific automation plugin without loosening every plugin's policy.
perPlugin.empty: No installed plugin currently declares native:input. Install or enable a plugin (e.g. cognia-computer-use) to manage per-plugin overrides here.
perPlugin.rowInheriting: Inherits the Plugin surface tier above.
perPlugin.title: Per-Plugin Overrides

permissions.perSurfaceDescription: Each automation surface can override the default tier.

surfaces.mcpDescription: MCP tool invocations from connected servers.

sandboxConnections.description: Run computer-use actions inside an isolated cua Docker desktop instead of this machine. Requires Docker on the host.
sandboxConnections.desktopOnly: Available in the desktop app only
sandboxConnections.name: Name
sandboxConnections.title: Computer-Use Sandboxes

screenOff.description: Keep Computer Use working when the monitor is off or asleep (the session must stay unlocked). Uses a bundled virtual display so screenshots never go black.
screenOff.enabledHint: Enable per character under Computer Use settings (screen-off mode).
screenOff.howItWorks: When a screen-off character drives the computer, a virtual display is created and made primary; it is released after 5 minutes idle, on the kill switch, or when the session closes.
screenOff.probeBlack: Capture returned a black frame — check the driver.
screenOff.setupNote: Until the driver is installed, screen-off turns error instead of capturing a black screen.
screenOff.title: Screen-off mode
screenOff.windowsOnlyNote: Screen-off mode is Windows-only. On this platform Computer Use uses the physical display.

whitelist.emptyProcess: No process names added yet. Add one above.
whitelist.emptyWindow: No window title patterns added yet. Add one above.
whitelist.processNamesHint: Case-insensitive exact match against the target process name (e.g. notepad.exe).
whitelist.quickCaptureHint: Read the currently focused window and prefill the fields below.
whitelist.windowTitlesHint: Glob patterns using * as wildcard (e.g. *Excel* or Untitled - Notepad).
